title: Cancer‑associated fibroblast‑derived extracellular vesicles promote pancreatic cancer progression via the RAP1B/ANLN axis.
snippet: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is one of the most lethal malignancies worldwide, characterized by late diagnosis, rapid progression and resistance to conventional therapies.
